theorems.name: Submission.rsod_weight_closedBall_eq_ofReal_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), closedBall x r ⊆ U → V.weight (closedBall x r) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in V.carrier ∩ closedBall x r, V.mult z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
